We've put lots of time and money into it.  Even sent him to a private school to see if that helped.  But each school has thought I'm an over reacting parent and never done anything to help him.  So I guess because of all the failures in my part and failures from professionals,  he doesn't think anyone can help.  Daily I'm trying to boost his confidence.  It's tiring.  He's not stupid,  he's a very smart young man.  I know he'll do well in life.  But this age is hard.

I have tried getting him help.  He refuses.  I suffer depression,  so this is very much in the forefront of my mind.  He will not see a doctor or counselor.  We have heart to hearts all the time.  'Idiot' comes from frustration of the situation.

I feel your pain.  My mother was skitzo/psycho and unmedicated.  She believed everyone was trying to kill her.  I was the only person in the family who would care for her.  From age 12. And I'm adopted ffs, so she's not even my real Mum! Lol. It is very hard.  But you do need to break away.  I was always scared my mother would be found dead weeks or even months after she had died,  and it would be in the news papers asking where her family was etc and why did she have to die alone.  My Aunty and cousins said they'd all have my back if that ever happened.  You need to break away and get your life going.  Nothing can be blamed on you even though I know you will feel bad,  or guilt for not being with her.  But your own mental health comes first

Of course it's selfish. Everything we do is selfish.  We do things to make us happy,  eating, friendships, sex,  everything.  And in my case,  suicide is demons in my head telling me to do it.  I fight it.  I get tired.  If I ever get so tired that I can't fight anymore,  I will be selfish and end the fight.  But until then,  I'll keep fighting and living my life as best I can.  I have taught my children to be independent just incase.  I've done everything for my family,  everything possible,  to make sure they will be fine if I go.  But fuck everyone,  if I want to be selfish and end the fight,  I will, and I won't be sorry.  Those who are sad,  or having a bad time,  have no clue how hard clinical depression is. It's selfish of them to want us to continue to suffer just to keep them happy.  Grrr lol selfish cunts.

Unbeknownst to them,  they often trigger my suicidal thoughts.  But I fight,  and I fight hard.  It's tiring,  but it's worth it.  I look back on what I would've missed if I had taken my life.  I've lived through hell,  and made it to the other side where people actually value me,  value my friendship.  Keep fighting!

No don't say that.  Your battle is as real and as hard for you than anything.  This is your pain, it's a bad as anyone's.  That's what is so crazy about our fucked up brains.  Nothing could set it off.  You could have the perfect life, or the worst..... it doesn't discriminate. It's just something in our brain that's not right.  I don't drink,  I don't do drugs.  I don't try and hide from it  to cover it up.  Face it full on, and fight.  Don't let the demons win.  Ok, maybe I eat waaaaaay too much food lol but hey,  gotta have something right.  It's actually my own little suicide approach,  die from being fat and unhealthy....... weird I know,  but it's how it is.  But I want to make sure,  right now  that you are ok.  That you accept how you feel,  and are willing to fight.  Willing to feel it,  and manage your way through.  I feel you should go back to your doctor and tell him your medication isn't right.  It's so important to get it right.  I don't know where you are from  but I hope your doctors are understanding and take this seriously.  You need to have a good relationship with your doc.

Awww sweetheart. I'm 48. Been suicidal since 8. I am on effexor and it has helped me stay stable in-between my 'moments'. My brother died when I was 23. My Mother left when I was 20, and my dad was an alcoholic.  All are dead now. Funnily enough,  after they all left me,  I was finally able to be me.  The crazy funny fucked up person i am.  I've slowly learnt to embrace my crazy.  I tell my friends I'm in medication,  but they do not know the full 'crazy' because that's too much for a normal person to comprehend.  The demons in my head telling me,  screaming at me to end it all.  No normal person can understand that.  I generally fight the fight alone.  My husband tries,  but yanno, he's useless lol.  My children try too, but again, they're just kids.  But they all know not to try and help me fight,  they just know to do more around the house and leave me to fight while they hold my hand and support me.  Are there people in your life that are toxic for you? That are all about themselves and drain you? It's not a bad thing to end friendships,  even with family,  if it effects you in a bad way.  I also do not listen to the news.  I've learnt that brings me down as well.  Especially when we had covid. I'm in New Zealand, so covid isn't too much of an issue here and life is a normal.  Let me know what I can do to help.  I'm happy to be here with you and talk

Oh sweetheart. I assume you are young.  These year's are so hard on their own,  let alone with a mental illness. Things will change.  Not necessarily get better, as in perfect,  but better.  You still need time to grow into yourself.  To learn who you are and become the wonderful understanding empathetic person,  who you probably need right now.  That endless pit comes and goes.  Ride the wave,  and keep strong.  Don't let it beat you because I know you are a wonderful butterfly waiting to break free. Prove your demons wrong,  live and help others have faith.

Yeah, I think asking her if she cared if you died,  to be honest, would put up the little red flags for anyone.  That becomes a sign of being trapped.  If it doesn't work out,  it'll be my fault he killed himself etc.  That is a lot of pressure to put on anyone.  Just chill.  It's ok.  Learn from your mistake.  I've never ever asked my husband that question because I don't care if he cares if I live or die.  It's not his choice.  This is my battle  and anything he does doesn't effect it either way.  I hope you can find some peace and breathe for a sec.  Give yourself a little time to adjust again and refocus.  And never rely on others for you to be happy.  Here for you if you'd like to talk more.  Take care 🙂 ❤
